nodes.label: Rationale: RoomDeleteResult enum (Success/NotFound/Conflict) used for room deletion because a plain bool/null cannot distinguish 404 Not Found from 409 Conflict (active bookings)
nodes.norm_label: rationale: roomdeleteresult enum (success/notfound/conflict) used for room deletion because a plain bool/null cannot distinguish 404 not found from 409 conflict (active bookings)

nodes.label: Rationale: HasOverlapAsync uses checkIn < b.CheckOut && checkOut > b.CheckIn — any new booking-date query must follow the same interval logic for consistency
nodes.norm_label: rationale: hasoverlapasync uses checkin < b.checkout && checkout > b.checkin — any new booking-date query must follow the same interval logic for consistency

nodes.norm_label: rationale: all dependency injection registration lives in program.cs — every new service/repository must be registered there with addscoped<interface, implementation>
